title: Godavari Grown Farm Location & Purity Benchmark
content: Godavari Grown is located in the fertile Godavari delta basin along the NH-16 corridor in Andhra Pradesh. We operate a high-tech vertical climate-controlled facility with 88-92% relative humidity. We use 100% organic local paddy straw sterilized via 4-hour 85°C steam. We use zero chemical pesticides, zero synthetic sprays, and zero bleach washes. All produce is certified FSSAI compliant with Below Detectable Limit (BDL) heavy metals.

title: Cultivated Mushroom Varieties
content: Godavari Grown harvests five primary varieties: 1) Godavari Milky White (Calocybe indica) - firm, meaty, excellent for South Indian curries and biryanis, 5 days shelf life. 2) Pearl and Blue Oyster (Pleurotus ostreatus) - delicate umami, natural lovastatin, cooks in 3 minutes. 3) Classic White Button (Agaricus bisporus) - tender and crisp. 4) Pure Lion's Mane (Hericium erinaceus) - brain vitality and focus superfood extract. 5) Dried Golden Cordyceps militaris - athletic stamina and ATP energy.

title: DIY Oyster Mushroom Home Grow Kit Guide
content: To grow mushrooms at home: 1) Cut a 2-inch 'X' slit on the front of the cardboard box. 2) Spray 4-5 spritzes of clean water using the provided mister bottle, 2 to 3 times a day. 3) Keep in a cool, well-ventilated spot away from direct sunlight. 4) Baby pinheads appear in 7 days, and full mushroom clusters will bloom in 10-14 days. 5) Gently twist off at the base to harvest. The kit yields 2 to 3 flushes with a 10-day rest period between flushes.

title: Storage & Freshness Guidelines
content: Store fresh mushrooms in the refrigerator vegetable drawer at 3°C to 6°C in our breathable micro-perforated packaging or a paper bag. Do NOT wash mushrooms before storing as moisture causes brown browning; simply rinse or dry brush right before cooking. Milky mushrooms have a shelf life of up to 5 days, Oyster mushrooms 3 to 4 days, and White Button 4 to 5 days.
